[SWS_DM_02161] Retrieval of SOVD entity data
⌈
If the SOVD method Query for data from an Entity is received without pa-
rameter, the DM shall send a response body according to ASAMSOVD[5][14] and add for each available DiagnosticSovdData an element to the items array with the
attributes (SOVD datatype ValueMetaData):
id set to the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContent,
name set to the longName of the DiagnosticSovdContent,
translation_id (optional SOVD parameter, not yet supported by AUTOSAR),
category set to DiagnosticSovdDataCategory.category of the Diagnos-
ticSovdDataCategory referenced by DiagnosticSovdData.sovdData-
Category,
group (if configured) set to the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdGroup.
⌋
